responsibility: Implements function splitting (partial inlining preparation) for separating cold or large regions of a function into a new helper clone. It analyzes per-basic-block size and time, searches dominator-based split points, tracks SSA and non-SSA values that must cross the split boundary, rewrites the original function to call the split part, and provides profile-aware and non-profile-aware pass entry points. This pass improves later inlining profitability rather than changing generic callgraph summaries.
